title: IDRBench: Benchmarking the Interactive Capabilities of Deep Research Agents
style: 双层灰底机器人流程图
description: We present IDRBench, a benchmark for systematically comparing deep research agents under both autonomous and interactive task settings (Figure 2).
author: XLCYun

images.caption: Overview of IDRBench. The benchmark combines a common research workflow with controlled clarification, query compression, model selection, and evaluation of task-specific report alignment and interaction cost.
